segments.text: What if you could talk to every top AI model at the same time on your Mac? This is Chorus, an open-source desktop app
that lets you chat with chat GPT, Claude, Gemini, and local models side by side in one place. No more guessing which model is right. Chorus shows you
all their answers at once. Chorus can see what's on your screen so the models understand what you're working on. No explaining.
